changeSet.author: ahri-medlab
changeSet.comment: Allow digits and common ID symbols in patient/participant name fields for MedLab research registration.

changeSet.author: ahri-medlab
changeSet.comment: Grant SamplePatientEntry (/rest/PatientManagement) to AHRI lab-unit roles used on MedLab Page 1. Without this, CTD-only users see "Not Authorized" even with lab-unit roles assigned.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_module (id, has_select, has_add, has_update, has_delete, system_role_id, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_role_module_seq'), 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', 'Y', role_row.id, module_row.id FROM clinlims.system_role role_row CROSS JOIN clinlims.system_module module_row WHERE module_row.name = 'SamplePatientEntry' AND role_row.name IN ( 'Sample Collector', 'Laboratory Technician', 'Lab Manager', 'Junior Researcher', 'Senior Researcher' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_module existing WHERE existing.system_role_id = role_row.id AND existing.system_module_id = module_row.id );
